changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS tax;

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql:
-- Global reference — no tenant_id, no RLS. Rows versioned by effective_from/to. CREATE TABLE tax.ptkp_statuses ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(100), annual_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, ter_category CHAR(1) NOT NULL CHECK (ter_category IN ('A','B','C')), effective_from DATE NOT NULL, effective_to DATE, UNIQUE (code, effective_from) );

changeSet.sql: -- UU HPP 2021 — annual progressive brackets (used for Desember reconciliation & resign) CREATE TABLE tax.tax_brackets_annual ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, bracket_from NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, bracket_to NUMERIC(18,2), rate_percent NUMERIC(6,4) NOT NULL, effective_from DATE NOT NULL, effective_to DATE ); INSERT INTO tax.tax_brackets_annual (bracket_from, bracket_to, rate_percent, effective_from) VALUES (0, 60000000, 0.05, '2022-01-01'), (60000001, 250000000, 0.15, '2022-01-01'), (250000001, 500000000, 0.25, '2022-01-01'), (500000001, 5000000000, 0.30, '2022-01-01'), (5000000001, NULL, 0.35, '2022-01-01');

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE tax.employee_tax_profiles ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, ptkp_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, npwp_encrypted BYTEA, has_npwp BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, tax_method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gross' CHECK (tax_method IN ('gross','gross_up','net')), is_expatriate BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tax_office_code VARCHAR(10), effective_from DATE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() );
CREATE TABLE tax.tax_calculations ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, payslip_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, period_year INT NOT NULL, period_month INT NOT NULL, calculation_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (calculation_type IN ('ter_monthly','annual_december','annual_resign','bonus','thr')), gross_taxable NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, ptkp_code VARCHAR(10), ter_category CHAR(1), ter_rate_percent NUMERIC(6,4), annual_gross NUMERIC(18,2), jabatan_deduction NUMERIC(18,2), pension_deduction NUMERIC(18,2), ptkp_amount NUMERIC(18,2), pkp NUMERIC(18,2), annual_pph21 NUMERIC(18,2), ytd_pph21_paid NUMERIC(18,2), pph21_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, rule_pack_version VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, calculation_detail JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE INDEX idx_tc_emp_period ON tax.tax_calculations(employee_id, period_year, period_month);

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE tax.bukti_potong_1721a1 ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, company_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, tax_year INT NOT NULL, bp_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, total_gross NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, total_pph21 NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, ptkp_code VARCHAR(10), is_final BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, pdf_url TEXT, ebupot_xml_url TEXT, issued_at TIMESTAMPTZ, issued_by UUID, UNIQUE (company_id, employee_id, tax_year) );

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql: -- RLS only on tenant-scoped tables; reference tables (ptkp_statuses, tax_brackets_*) are global. DO $$ DECLARE tbl TEXT; BEGIN FOR tbl IN SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid WHERE n.nspname='tax' AND c.relkind='r' AND a.attname='tenant_id' AND NOT a.attisdropped LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE tax.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;', tbl); EXECUTE format( 'CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tax.%I USING (tenant_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting(''app.current_tenant_id'', true), ''''), ''00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'')::uuid);', tbl); END LOOP; END $$;
